findings.title: Пустой экран до начала загрузки
findings.evidence: queryChanged waits300ms while isLoading=false and logs=[]; initialDebouncedQueryMustShowLoadingInsteadOfEmpty fails.
findings.proposal: Immediate initial loading; debounce only changed search; distinct unrequested/loading/empty/error.

findings.title: Старые приватные данные после удаления или отказа
findings.evidence: refreshLogDetail nil leaves cached row/fallback; explicit permission-denied refresh retains rows. Two red probes. Push-destination load also leaves previous log on catch.
findings.proposal: Withdraw data/actions on confirmed deletion or authorization loss, preserve known rows only for recoverable connectivity failures; fence route/detail/session generations.

findings.title: Не восстанавливается истёкшая страница
findings.evidence: Server cursor expiry1h returns aborted; loadNextPage retry reuses exact expired cursor indefinitely. Red probe.
findings.proposal: Localized refresh-required recovery and correct first-page restart; retain exact cursor for transient network failure.

findings.title: Поздняя загрузка возвращает удалённую строку
findings.evidence: deleteLog does not invalidate pending list response; completedDeleteCannotBeUndoneByOldListResponse fails.
findings.proposal: Guard mutations against pending refresh/page/detail results and verify after reopen.

findings.title: В периодах лишний календарный день
findings.evidence: 7 days starts startOfToday-7 (8 calendar dates incl today);30 uses-30 (31 dates). Seven-date boundary probe fails.
findings.proposal: Consistent inclusive periods today plus6/29 previous dates; test midnight,DST and combined quick/advanced filters.

findings.title: Некоторые серверные причины становятся общей ошибкой
findings.evidence: readableErrorMessage matches English description text, not typed Functions codes. permissionDenied code7 with standard NSError text becomes generic; red probe.
findings.proposal: Typed auth/permission/network/cursor handling without asserting invented causes; localized retry directions.

findings.title: Лишние чтения при фильтрации и пагинации
findings.evidence: queryJournal reads250 candidates even for small result limit; category/date/review/severity filters mostly applied after read; initial sparse scan can call8 pages=2000 candidate reads, plus auth/index overhead. scanned reports processed docs, not full fetched count.
findings.proposal: Push selective filters into indexed server query where feasible; distinguish fetched/processed counts, cap work, avoid repeat empty-page traversal; benchmark isolated large fixture.

findings.title: Нарушена компоновка крупного текста
findings.evidence: Actual maximum-AX uk/de screenshots show icon/number overlaps and severe chip/title/date truncation; fixed icon surfaces combined with scaling fonts and adaptive chip widths. Standard de metric subtitle also clipped.
findings.proposal: AX stacked full-width labels/chips and properly sized icons, compact secondary copy; recheck every nested window, themes, contrast and hit areas.

findings.title: Названия и пояснения противоречат содержимому
findings.evidence: Admin journal title is Журнал модерації but includes errors/organizations/users. Loaded metrics note also says search only applies to loaded entries, although listSystemLogs searches whole journal.
findings.proposal: Name limited journal Журнал подій or Журнал адміністратора; state precise counter scope and whole-journal search; remove repeated explanations.

findings.title: Отслеживается отсутствие запуска не всех задач
findings.evidence: Actual no-success policy covers7 of14 enabled jobs.7 enabled lack absence coverage: migrateLegacyContentMedia,rollupBannerMeasurementReports,cleanupStaleFeaturedBannerOrphans,cleanupExpiredData,cleanupUnverifiedAccounts,cleanupStaleContentMediaOrphans,cleanupAnnouncements. Per-attempt failure logging does not detect a job never running.
findings.proposal: Extend schedule-appropriate missing-success coverage with timezone/deploy grace; preserve intentional photo-cleanup pause and gates. Verify saved policies and subsequent natural executions.

nestedVisualUI.observed: uk/light +de/dark standard filters/detail/technical/copy; both largest dashboard/row/detail. Test name contains Review but does not exercise review mutation; not claimed.

desiredContractProbes.meaning: Intentional red audit probes exposing current product defects; not committed into active test targets. Product not changed.

confirmationUI.scope: clear + single delete confirmations, outside/cancel dismissal, rows retained; fixtures only

verification.driverCorrections: First max UI driver waited for lazy rows before scrolling and did not horizontally reveal filters; corrected and NestedVisual passed. Native confirmation popover can omit Cancel and dismiss outside; initial failed selector is not counted as product failure. All failed artifacts retained.

productionReadback.meaning: Exact TS+compiled JS of each7 relevant handlers and auth/permissions matches current local source; unrelated older journalQuery export in other deployed packages is not falsely called active-handler drift. All7 Ready/100% traffic/onDeployUpdatePolicy.
productionReadback.actualJournalNoticeSourceMatch: Existing network diagnostic received after offline delay matches owner notification with durable receipt complete. This does not prove a fresh physical-device delivery now.
productionReadback.errorsWindow: Cloud Logging severity>=ERROR from2026-10-27T00:00Z through initial09:42UTC read:0; not proof of absence of warnings or open incidents.
productionReadback.pausedJob: cleanupOrganizationPhotoLifecycle was intentionally paused in historical rollout and has separate photoCleanupEnabled/legacyPhotoSweepEnabled gates; no activation made.

storage.interpretation: Monitoring threshold, not a bucket capacity/quota claim; no files deleted.

improvementApproach: Fix correctness and stale data first, then bounded query work and visual adaptation.
Keep one journal with role-scoped sections; avoid adding a duplicate moderation/publication dashboard.
Keep exact technical details in disclosure and concise action/impact/retry on front.
Preserve privacy redaction, owner-only alerts, idempotency, MFA, quotas, retention and old-client compatibility.
Repeat seven exact red probes after approved implementation, then full regression, nested visual matrix and source-matching CI.
